searchText: For this type of doubts the ethstaker Discord better suited to help you. I personally don't use any special NTP config beyond what's default in ubuntu Hey guys not sure if i am asking in the right group but any help would be helpful. lets say i have 5 validator in active state having same withdrawal address, and i am getting skimmed rewards. Can i separate out validator wise skimmed rewards shares. <@755590043632140352> you can separate by validator index, you can prove against the beacon state that a withdrawal has been executed will i get msg.data in the skimmed reward transaction on execution layer to check the validator index or i will have to do that part on client side requirement is to know each validator share of skimmed reward on-chain withdrawals dont have any EVM execution attached it works a bit like coinbase payments in pre-Merge ethereum -- just a balance update okay so if i want to segregate validator wise skimmed reward, best way is to provide different withdrawal address, is that the right understanding? I can not use same withdrawal address for all validators in that case even with doing offchain segregation. thats a simple way to do it you can even use a separate address per validator, which is a better design privacy-wise got it, thanks <@539495253418180618> Awesome thank you Thanks for the information 😤 I suppose so… 😓 danke FYI the ITU-R WRC will vote this year again on the issue of Leap Seconds in UTC after deferring it in 2015 to this year’s conference not strictly observing the same behavior of a normal balance update semantics correct? i’d say it’s the “normal” behavior, you just don’t have any evm execution so no nonce check or gas purchase and no evm execution

excerpts.author: dapplion
excerpts.content: For this type of doubts the ethstaker Discord better suited to help you. I personally don't use any special NTP config beyond what's default in ubuntu

excerpts.author: sanjayy1702
excerpts.content:
Hey guys not sure if i am asking in the right group but any help would be helpful.

lets say i have 5 validator in active state having same withdrawal address, and i am getting skimmed rewards. Can i separate out  validator wise skimmed rewards shares.

excerpts.author: potuz
excerpts.content: you can separate by validator index, you can prove against the beacon state that a withdrawal has been executed

excerpts.author: sanjayy1702
excerpts.content: will i get msg.data in the skimmed reward transaction on execution layer to check the validator index or i will have to do that part on client side

excerpts.author: sanjayy1702
excerpts.content: requirement is to  know each validator share of skimmed reward on-chain

excerpts.author: ralexstokes
excerpts.content: withdrawals dont have any EVM execution attached

excerpts.author: ralexstokes
excerpts.content: it works a bit like coinbase payments in pre-Merge ethereum -- just a balance update

excerpts.author: sanjayy1702
excerpts.content:
okay so if i want to segregate validator wise skimmed reward, best way is to provide different withdrawal address, is that the right understanding?

I can not use same withdrawal address for all validators in that case even with doing offchain segregation.

excerpts.author: ralexstokes
excerpts.content: thats a simple way to do it

excerpts.author: ralexstokes
excerpts.content: you can even use a separate address per validator, which is a better design privacy-wise
